description: GPT-6 Luna is OpenAI's efficient reasoning model for focused, high-volume tasks. It accepts text and images, generates text, and supports a 1,050,000-token context window with up to 128,000 output tokens. Configurable reasoning effort, structured outputs, prompt caching, and Responses API tools support cost-sensitive applications, coding tasks, and automated workflows.
name: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna (Fast)
